html.htmlText:
Discover a world of peace & inspiration at The Pause Project, a cozy romantic Airbnb nestled in the middle of a lush forest in Siolim, North Goa.

Perfect for solo travelers, couples & families, it offers a space to slow down.

Immerse yourself in books, music, travel memories & a lived-in ambience that feels like home. Cook a meal in the kitchenette or explore Siolim, known for its cafes & bars, with Anjuna, Vagator, Assagao & Morjim, Mandrem beaches 15-20 min away & 35 min from MOPA airport.

The space, Whyt at The Pause Project, does not allow for smoking but guests can smoke only in the outside areas.

We request guests to not smoke inside any of the rooms.

We request guests to take necessary security measures so as to not cause any damages or danger to self, others, Whyt, or it's furniture and furnishings.

html.htmlText:
Service animals aren’t pets, so there’s no need to add them here.

Travelling with an emotional support animal? Check out our accessibility policy.

content.htmlText:
The Pause Project is centrally located in North Goa with most hotspots just 10-15 mins away. Anjuna, Vagator, Chapora, Morjim, and Ashwem are 10-15 mins. Baga, Calangute, Mandrem, Mapusa, and the Green Belt are 15-25 mins away. It takes about 75 mins from the airport and railway station to get here.

Right next door is Hangout Bar and a liquor shop, Valanka Wines. There are a few more gorgeous villas and buildings around, but at sufficient distance ensuring privacy.

A few minutes away (walking, 300-500m) are some must visit places like El Patron, Thalassa, and Oh! La La. A few minutes further (1 km) offers breathtaking views of the Chapora river meeting the Arabian Sea in between two hills, where Badem Deck serves great tea (perfect for sunsets) and local food like Xacuti, Vindaloo, Poi, etc.

On the other side, just a few minutes away is the gorgeous Siolim Church, which really draws one's attention to it in the night owing to the elegant lighting on a towering structure, very unassuming for a quaint town like Siolim, with shops that sell everything you may need, even supermarkets.

section.about:
Hi. We are Siddhartha and Pavika - marketing professionals who moved to Goa, away from the city life. We both have always loved hosting people which led us to start an AirBnB. Our goal is to provide travellers and working professionals a space to (work from and) really take a break while they explore Goa. We want to offer our guests the most comfortable and relaxing spaces that are also not exorbitant, so they can enjoy Goa and the positive energy it has to offer. 

Besides our professional pursuits and being hosts, one of us is also a food scientist and the other is also a musician, and our personalities reflect in the spaces we've built. 

Ask us for our curated list of places to visit in Goa!
